name: Translated Letter
summary: The Translated Letter is the deciphered message penned by the hermit Abercrombie and translated by Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire. It must be carried urgently to Lord Ello Ebonlocke, who needs to understand the warning it contains.

sections.title: A Gruesome Revelation
sections.body: What began as errands of mercy for a seemingly helpless hermit in Raven Hill takes a dark turn with this parchment. Written in an obscure hand, Abercrombie's message to Mayor Ello Ebonlocke remained an enigma until brought to Sirra Von'Indi for translation. The decoded text lays bare the hermit's true identity as the Embalmer. Rather than living in harmless solitude, Abercrombie used the supplies brought to him to construct a monstrous abomination named Stitches, unleashing the hulking creation to trample and slaughter the people of Darkshire.

sections.title: The Price of Good Intentions
sections.body: Presenting the translated missive to Lord Ello Ebonlocke drains all color from the mayor's face. While the traveler's assistance was offered out of genuine goodwill, the note proves that Abercrombie played them for a fool, using their labor to fashion an instrument of absolute slaughter. As the town council scrambles to marshal the Night Watch, the deciphered note serves as a chilling testament to how easily charity can be twisted into devastation across the haunted roads of Duskwood.

faq.q: What does the Translated Letter say?
faq.answer: It contains an alarming message from Abercrombie for Lord Ello Ebonlocke. Its full contents are revealed when the translated note is delivered in Darkshire.
Sirra Von'Indi, a scholar residing in Darkshire, translates Abercrombie's cryptic handwriting and warns you to hurry back to Lord Ello with the alarming news.

faq.q: What happens when Ello reads the letter?
faq.answer: Ello is deeply alarmed by the translation. Bring it to him to learn what it means for Darkshire.

faq.q: Can I throw away the Translated Letter after the quest?
faq.answer: Yes. Once Lord Ello inspects the parchment and advances the town's defense, the letter remains in your pack as a souvenir and serves no further functional purpose.

angles.text: The missive marks a devastating moment of reckoning for Alliance travelers in Duskwood, proving that even pure intentions can be weaponized against the fragile defenders of Darkshire.
